description: This Java class 'Token' represents tokens used in an expression parser or evaluator, encapsulating various token types such as operators, functions, and literals, along with utility methods for token creation and type checking.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: A class representing a token in an expression, including its type and content, with methods to create tokens of different kinds and check token types.

methods.name: buildLiteral
methods.description: Factory method to create a literal token with a string content.

methods.name: buildOperator
methods.description: Factory method to create an operator token from an Operator object.

methods.name: buildFunction
methods.description: Factory method to create a function token from a Function object.

methods.name: buildOpenToken
methods.description: Factory method to create an open bracket token with a BracketPair.

methods.name: buildCloseToken
methods.description: Factory method to create a close bracket token with a BracketPair.

methods.name: getBrackets
methods.description: Returns the BracketPair associated with this token, if any.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the Operator object if this token is an operator.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Returns the Function object if this token is a function.

methods.name: getKind
methods.description: Returns the kind/type of the token (e.g., operator, literal, etc.).

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Checks if the token is an operator.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if the token is a function.

methods.name: isOpenBracket
methods.description: Checks if the token is an open bracket.

methods.name: isCloseBracket
methods.description: Checks if the token is a close bracket.

methods.name: isFunctionArgumentSeparator
methods.description: Checks if the token is a function argument separator.

methods.name: isLiteral
methods.description: Checks if the token is a literal, constant, or variable name.

methods.name: getAssociativity
methods.description: Returns the associativity of the operator if applicable.

methods.name: getPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the precedence level of the operator if applicable.

methods.name: getLiteral
methods.description: Returns the literal string content of the token, or throws if not a literal.

methods.name: getBooleanHackedLiteral
methods.description: Returns '1' or '0' if the literal is boolean true or false, respectively; otherwise returns the literal string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Token object.
